# Gentle Care Nursing Services

Canonical site: https://gentlecarenursing.com.au

In-home nursing and personal care in Sydney and surrounds. This is a navigation guide, not evidence of provider registration, clinical suitability or funding approval.

## Enquiries, privacy and safety

- Availability, care suitability, funding and eligibility must be confirmed with the team before services are arranged.
- Our team will review your enquiry and discuss availability and next steps. Submitting a form does not book a care service.
- Website forms are for initial enquiries only. Do not include detailed medical records, identity documents, payment details or NDIS plan numbers. Contact the team to arrange an appropriate way to share documents needed for care assessment.
- If referring someone else, obtain their permission or make sure you have authority to do so.
- For a medical emergency in Australia, call 000. The website and business phone are not emergency services.
